blocks.text: Atomic radius atom ke size ka measure (naap) hai. Yeh aapas mein bonded (jure hue) do ek jaise atoms ke beech fasle ka aadha hota hai. Atomic radius bond ki type (covalent, metallic ya van der Waals forces) ya atom ki state (halat) ke mutabiq badal sakta hai. Maslan covalent bond mein radius ionic bond se alag ho sakta hai. Atomic radius aam taur par picometers (pm) ya Angstroms (Å) mein napa jata hai.

blocks.alt: Atoms golon ki shakal mein, apne radius ke mutabiq chhote bare: purane groups 1 se 8 baen se daen aur periods 1 se 6 oopar se neeche: H aur He; Li se Ne; Na se Ar; K, Ca aur Ga se Kr; Rb, Sr aur In se Xe; Cs, Ba aur Tl se Rn. Oopar ka arrow (teer) 'atomic size decreases' (baen se daen) aur baen ka arrow 'atomic size increases' (neeche ki taraf).
blocks.caption: Fig 1.4: Periods mein aur groups mein neeche atomic radius ki tabdeeli (kitab ki Fig 1.4 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har sphere (gola) ek atom hai aur us ka size atomic radius dikhata hai. Ek row (period) mein baen se daen gole chhote hote jate hain, kyun ke nuclear charge barhta hai aur electrons qareeb khinch jate hain. Ek column (group) mein neeche gole bare hote jate hain, kyun ke har qadam par naya shell jurta hai. Kitab ki figure mein kuch symbols ghalat chhape hain: H ki jagah '11', Cl ki jagah 'Ci', Ge ki jagah 'Gc', Se ki jagah 'Sc', In ki jagah 'ln', Te ki jagah 'Tc', Xe ki jagah 'Xc' aur Po ki jagah 'Pa'. Yahan sahi symbols likhe gaye hain.
